boundary_sensitivity.method: s = 1e3*L*sigma*eps is linear in the production BR for each sample group; the delivered signal_scan curves are re-weighted row by row with production-module rate ratios (s_new = s_B f_B + s_inel f_inel + s_h f_h) and the 90% CL crossing s=2.302585 is re-solved. No response table is rebuilt. mH=2 and 4 are ln-ln interpolated between the bracketing scan nodes.

findings.title: nominal B->X_s H rate uses the B-MESON phase space (1-mH^2/m_B^2)^2, the printed paper formula has (1-mH^2/m_b^2)^2 with m_b=4.18
findings.paper: Eq. B->X_s phi (Sec. 2.2, between eq:Lfceff_phi and Fig. 1) + line 299 (m_b=4.18)
findings.literal_match: mode 'paper_mb' matches the printed formula literally; 'foresee' matches the paper's own FORESEE numerical model and its stated 'reach up to m_B' (line 757)
findings.recommendation: report mode='paper_mb' as the literal-formula result; keep 'foresee' as the paper-figure/FORESEE variant. At mH>=4 the difference is catastrophic (-50%) and must not be hidden in a band.

findings.title: CKM parameter choice: exactly unitary matrix |Vts|=0.04012 vs the DESIGN.md nominal magnitudes |Vts|=0.0415, |Vtd|=0.0086
findings.paper: paper gives no CKM values (only Vcb used in the formula); parameter choice
findings.recommendation: document that the unitary set lowers BR(B->XsH) by ~6.5% and hence the tanb boundary by ~1-2%; the K->pi H rate moves +13% (no effect on the long-lived boundary). Keep the unitary set (more correct) and state it.

findings.title: B0 lifetime scaling 0.92735 applied; the paper text says Br(B->Xc e nu)=0.104 for both B0 and B+
findings.note: code agrees with the Boiarska caption and FORESEE (mB/Gamma_B per meson); the literal sentence would raise the B0 rate 7.8% -> s_B +3.9% (B0 fraction 0.50)
findings.recommendation: keep the code; cite Boiarska caption/FORESEE instead of the sentence

findings.title: kappa_gamma has no charged-Higgs loop; the paper eq. coup_hgaga_Hpm is written for H but the h H+H- coupling is not suppressed either
findings.paper: eq. coup_hgaga (152-154, App. A) + eq. coup_hgaga_Hpm (522-524)
findings.recommendation: no action for this analysis (gamma gamma is 0.227% of Gamma_h_other and the h channel is < 1e-7 of s at the boundary); fix only if h->HH is ever promoted

findings.title: paper internal inconsistency on Br(h->HH): prose 75 c^4 vs the paper equations 19.7 c^4 (and the printed 8 pi m_h^2 denominator is dimensionally inconsistent)
findings.note: code implements App. C g_hHH and Gamma=g^2 beta/(8 pi m_h), i.e. the 4733 coefficient; a 4x width convention or the prose 75 c^4 moves ONLY the short-lived (outside-validity) crossing, by the numbers in boundary_sensitivity.deviations_short_crossing
findings.recommendation: state in the write-up which convention is used; do not quote 75 c^4

findings.title: K0L isospin coefficient taken as 1 (same amplitude with neutral masses); the paper gives no SU(2) coefficient
findings.note: K0L/K+ = 4.32 vs Boiarska table 4.12 (the table uses the charged-K matrix element); K channel is closed above 0.354 GeV and s_inel/s_B < 2e-6 at every long-lived boundary -> zero effect

B3_B_XsH_paper_mb.title: B->X_s H literal paper Eq (m_b=4.18 phase space)

B4_B_XsH_foresee.title: B->X_s H nominal 'foresee' (m_B phase space, m_B-m_K endpoint)
B4_B_XsH_foresee.note: audit reference = same paper Eq with m_ps=m_B and the m_B-m_K cutoff; this mode does NOT correspond to the printed paper formula (which has m_b)

B5_K_to_piH.title: K->pi H amplitude (Eq. Matrix_4FH, coherent) and BR

B6_semileptonic.title: pi/K -> H e nu (paper Eq. after n_h,n_l)

B7_h_to_HH.title: g_hHH (eq. ghHH) / Gamma(h->HH) official-width convention
B7_h_to_HH.note: code: g3=-2 g_C, Gamma=|g3|^2/(32 pi m_h) beta == g_C^2/(8 pi m_h) beta, i.e. the paper convention implied by 4700 = v^2/(8 pi m_h Gamma_hSM); the literal printed denominator 8 pi m_h^2 is dimensionally inconsistent; L=-1/2 convention is 4x smaller

B8_higgs_production.title: kappa_g (coup_hgg), kappa_gamma (coup_hgaga), per-process sigma scaling
B8_higgs_production.note: kappa_gamma has no H+ loop (paper eq. coup_hgaga_Hpm written for H, applies to h too; affects only BR(h->gamma gamma) = 0.227% of Gamma_h_other -> negligible); per-process scaling is the DESIGN/paper kappa framework, not a paper equation

B9_B0_lifetime.title: BR(B0->XsH) = Gamma_B+/Gamma_B0 * BR(B+->XsH)
B9_B0_lifetime.note: paper line 180: Br(B->Xc e nu)=0.104 for both B0 and B+-. Literal reading gives BR(B0)=BR(B+); code follows the physical/Boiarska caption lifetime scaling 0.92735 (also what FORESEE does via mB/Gamma_B per meson).
B9_B0_lifetime.verdict: consistent with Boiarska caption / FORESEE; differs from the literal sentence by 7.8%

B10_b_channels_K.title: b_channels K-channel shape vs Boiarska master formula

B11_exclusive_sum.title: Boiarska b->s exclusive sum at mS->0 (their eq. total-exclusive: 3.3 theta^2)
B11_exclusive_sum.note: sum over the 9 b->s channels of b_channels.shape_channels(0) * XI_SB^2; Boiarska table tab:BR sum + eq. total-exclusive

C1_xi_limit.title: xi_H^{ij} -> 0 as tanb -> inf
C1_xi_limit.note: FCNC xi_H^{ij} falls like 1/tanb (not 1/tanb^3: the tree-level xi_H^f identity does not apply to the loop-induced FCNC coupling); DESIGN line 90 "like 1/tanb" is correct

C4_FORESEE_bracket.title: top-quark bracket vs FORESEE fitted F(c) (paper numerical model)
C4_FORESEE_bracket.note: FORESEE (paper ref) g_Hsb uses the same bracket and m_B spectator phase space; the 0.7% difference is their fit quality

C5_K_vs_Boiarska.title: K->pi H FCNC term vs Boiarska master formula
C5_K_vs_Boiarska.note: identical amplitude structure; residual = quark-mass constants m_s=0.096/0.0047 vs Boiarska 0.0924/0.00467; four-quark term adds +0.12% rate but -6.2% interference

C6_K0_isospin.title: K0L -> pi0 H isospin coefficient
C6_K0_isospin.note: code uses the SAME amplitude formula with neutral masses -> ratio 4.32; the Boiarska table ratio 4.12 corresponds to using the charged-K matrix element for K0L. The paper does not give the SU(2) coefficient; factor-1 is documented. Zero effect on the long-lived boundary (K channel closed above 0.354 GeV and s_inel/s_B < 2e-6).

C7_h_HH_paper_prose.title: h->HH vs the paper prose (75 c^4, 4700 (g/v)^2, -mh^2c^2/4v)
C7_h_HH_paper_prose.note: App. C g_hHH gives |g| = mh^2 c^2/(4v) at mH->0 (paper prose has the right magnitude and the wrong sign); the 4700 relation follows from Gamma=g^2 beta/(8 pi m_h); the prose "Br ~ 75 c^4" is inconsistent with the paper equations by a factor 3.8 (it needs |g| = mh^2 c^2/(2v)). Code follows the equations.
C7_h_HH_paper_prose.verdict: PAPER INCONSISTENCY, code follows the equations

C8_sigma_SM_limit.title: sigma_total -> sum of SM cross sections as tanb -> inf

C10_channel_list.title: exclusive b->s channel list (shape only)
C10_channel_list.note: Boiarska b->s entries only, B_s absent (as in Boiarska/FORESEE); used ONLY as a normalised kinematic shape, never added to the inclusive rate

C11_FORESEE_numeric.title: nominal 'foresee' vs the paper's own FORESEE 2HDM_H formula
C11_FORESEE_numeric.note: FORESEE: BR = 9.68544e-13 (mB/GammaB)(1-mH^2/mB^2)^2 F(tanb)^2 (mB phase space, spectator normalisation); agreement is 1.6% flat in mH
C11_FORESEE_numeric.verdict: PASS (1.6% normalisation of the paper fit)

D0b_reweight_validation.title: re-weighting of s_B with production BR ratios reproduces the Lead independent paper_mb/exclusive scans

D1_composition.title: s composition at the 90% CL long-lived tanb boundary
D1_composition.note: at every boundary the B channel carries ~all of s; inel < 2e-6 and h < 1e-7 of s, so K/pi/h production formulas cannot move the long-lived boundary
